name: Send Hyperliquid wallet fill alerts to Telegram

parameters.content:
# Send Hyperliquid wallet fill alerts to Telegram

## Who is this for?

Anyone following a public Hyperliquid trading address who wants alerts without repeatedly checking a dashboard. Use one lower-volume wallet per workflow.

## How it works

Every five minutes, the workflow reads Hyperliquid’s public Info API. The first scheduled run silently establishes a baseline. Later runs deduplicate fills and send a Telegram summary showing up to six recent trades, including perpetual position changes, prices, sizes, and available fees.

Each alert links to the same address in the [Market Depth Lab Hyperliquid Wallet Tracker](https://marketdepthlab.com/tools/hyperliquid-wallet-tracker/). Market Depth Lab created this template and companion tool.

## Requirements and setup

1. Import into n8n. Enter a public master-account or subaccount address, label, and Telegram chat ID in **Wallet settings**.
2. Select your Telegram bot credential in **Telegram alert**.
3. Run **Preview manually** and inspect the final output; manual runs never send messages or save checkpoints.
4. Activate when ready. Check execution history for failures.

No wallet connection, private key, or Hyperliquid trading API key is needed.

## Customization and limits

Change the address and label for another wallet. Keep executions sequential. This monitors fills, not deposits, withdrawals, or funding.

Static-data persistence is experimental. Interrupted deliveries can duplicate alerts; late fills can be missed. Responses of 500+ fills or checkpoint gaps over 24 hours stop with an error. See workflow notes for details.

## 2. Read public fills
Every five minutes, query Hyperliquid with a two-minute overlap and a ten-second delay. First scheduled success creates a silent baseline.

500+ rows, malformed responses or a gap over 24 hours stop the run instead of silently skipping history. Intended for lower-volume wallets, not high-frequency accounts.

## 3. Alert, then checkpoint
One message per batch, latest six fills shown. Spot codes and returned HIP-3 prefixes are preserved. Position-change labels apply to perpetual fills.

Link opens the selected address in Market Depth Lab. No trading action is performed.

## Before publishing this workflow in n8n
Use one sequential execution per workflow; timeout is 120s, schedule is 5m. Static data persists only after successful **published/active scheduled** runs. It is experimental and not suitable for high-frequency/overlapping runs.

Check Executions for API errors; attach your own error workflow if needed. Delivery is at-least-once: an interrupted send/checkpoint may duplicate a message. Late records beyond the overlap and upstream retention limits may be missed.

This monitors returned fills for one address, not deposits, withdrawals, funding, all subaccounts or a complete cross-DEX portfolio. Clone the workflow for another address; check limits before scaling.
